recognize_zh: 低倍下一個骨髓顆粒（particle）內及周圍可見多顆大型、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞，數量明顯多於一般每個顆粒 1–3 顆，提示巨核細胞增多。
features: Low-power view of a cellular marrow particle with interspersed fat vacuoles
Multiple large megakaryocytes clustered within and at the edge of the particle
Megakaryocytes show abundant cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei; detailed nuclear morphology limited at this magnification
Background of peripheral blood red cells and scattered leukocytes around the particle
Individual megakaryocyte dysplasia cannot be assessed at this power
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with admixed fat containing numerous megakaryocytes, several of which are clustered within and around the particle. The megakaryocytes appear large with abundant cytoplasm, though nuclear detail and dysplastic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryocytes; causes include peripheral platelet destruction (e.g., ITP), reactive thrombocytosis and myeloproliferative neoplasms, and correlation with platelet count and higher-power morphology is needed.

ddx.vs: Shows increased megakaryocytes that are morphologically normal or immature on high power with a low platelet count, so clinical correlation rather than this low-power view separates it.
Features large hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocytes in loose clusters on biopsy with thrombocytosis and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters of many smaller cells with high N:C ratio, rather than individual large cells with abundant granular cytoplasm.
